text_en: It was narrated from Anas: "I prayed with the Prophet (ﷺ) and with Abu Bakr and Umar, may Allah be pleased with them both, and they started with "All the praise and thanks be to Allah, the Lord of all that exists."
text_id: Telah mengabarkan kepada kami [Abdullah bin Muhammad bin 'Abdurrahman Az Zuhri] dia berkata; telah menceritakan kepada kami [Sufyan] dari [Ayyub] dari [Qatadah] dari [Anas] dia berkata; "Aku pernah shalat bersama Rasulullah Shallallahu'alihiwasallam Abu Bakar, serta Umar Radliyallahu'anhum, dan mereka mengawalinya dengan membaca, 'Alhamdulillah Rabbil 'Alamin.'
